scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --raw "bun --cwd apps/web run dev" "bun --cwd apps/pocketbase run dev"
scripts.build: bun run check:structure && bun --cwd apps/web run build && bun --cwd apps/pocketbase run build
scripts.lint: bun run check:structure && bun --cwd apps/web run lint && bun --cwd apps/pocketbase run lint
scripts.typecheck: bun run check:structure && bun --cwd apps/web run typecheck && bun --cwd apps/pocketbase run typecheck
